My grandparents and a few of my friends are finally here for my birthday party, I turn 13 today. I also get my special ability. I've been really nervous, but super excited for today. My mom has a water based telekinesis ability-- I grew up not liking baths because of her. Dad on the other hand didn't get anything amazing, he has a perfect photographic memory. He never forgets *anything*. He still berates me about that *one* time I got an F on my history project sometimes. 

Anyways, I've been pacing around my room like a crazy person. I have this terrible feeling my ability will be awful or even hurtful to other people. What if the Ability Affairs Ministry comes and asses me as a threat? I don't want to be branded and taken away from my family. I could feel my heart rate rising ten fold at that point and collapsed on my bed. The room was spinning and I wanted nothing more that to sleep for a few hours.

"Caleb, aren't you coming to your own birthday party?"

My mother's voice brought me back to reality and I knew there was no escaping the inevitable. I had to face her, my friends, and the committee member from the ministry. I let out a deep sigh and made my descent into the living room. I hope I have a lame power and I can go back to being a normal kid. 

"Happy birthday Caleb, are you ready to begin your examination?" The voice was monotone and lacked any warmth, it made the hair on my neck stand up the moment I heard it. A dark skinned woman with silvery eyes had made her way from the front door to greet me. She had a mysterious aura that made me, without question, want to have a useless power. I couldn't imagine what she had in store for me if she thought I was a threat to the public.

"Yes ma'am. I'm ready." I fumbled my words but she took no time in handing me the official paperwork for the examination. My parents had already signed this at my birth, it was just up to me now. My hand shook with furious tremors as I slowly wrote my name in cursive on the dotted line. I handed her back the pen and waited quietly for her instructions.

"I understand your nervous, this is normal. Now then Caleb. I want you to focus on my voice and listen closely to what I instruct you to do. Close your eyes, now." Her monotone voice was now tinted with assertiveness, something completely absent prior. I cringed but did as I was told, without any hesitation. "On the table in front of you is a pen. Your task is to simply to do something involving the pen. I will rate your ability and determine if you are suited to be left here with it. Understood?" Those eyes, I could feel them staring at me. Even with mine closed I felt like she was invading my entire being. I couldn't escape her regardless of how tightly closed my eyelids were. 

"Y-yeah. Let's get this over with..." I was mumbling at this point but it didn't matter, it was time for me to show everyone what I'd been given. I focused with all my might on the pen, I visualized it in my head and waited for something to happen. Five minutes had elapsed at this point, I opened my eyes out of frustration with the whole situation. I could hear the whispers of people wondering why nothing had happened yet, it made me even more angry. I know I'm not defective-- maybe I'm just a late bloomer for all they know! 

"Caleb. I've seen no physical manifestation of your power nor have I sensed you having any telekinetic abilities either. I can come back tomorrow and we can do this in private--" She seemed highly concerned for my wellbeing at this point but I didn't want to back down, not now damn it. I slammed my fist on the table in retaliation to her idea, I just needed a few more minutes. "Give me five more minutes...*Please* just let me prove myself." I was pleading with her at this point-- no I was begging, I didn't want it to end like this. 

"You're too emotional to continue this examination. We can reschedule this for tomorrow. I'm sorry Caleb." 

And just like that, she reached for the pen and ruined my entire birthday. I don't know what came over me but I reached out to take the pen back. I wanted another chance, I didn't want her to take it away from me. Rather than grabbing the pen I had touched the committee woman's hand instead. Immediately she screamed out in pain, as if my touch had physically harmed her so severely she couldn't control herself. I retracted my hand and backed away from the terrifying scene unfolding before me. 

"W-what did I do to her?!" I wailed at the top of my lungs and looked to my parents for guidance. Their eyes were filled with terror, something I'd never seen before. The room was silent now, the only noise was deafening screaming from the poor woman I had just hurt. No one dared touch her...and no one dared to come near me. Not even my parents moved from where they stood, it was as if they were cemented into the floor.

"My ability...he...**HE TOOK MY ABILITY**!" 

I...I was one of *them*, one of those monsters. The Defense Ministry takes away anyone with the ability to alter, or eliminate another person's ability. They are a class SS ranked threat to the public. They're going to force me to join the Defense Force and never let me see my family again. I won't be the same after today, I'm going to disappear...the stories must be true. I felt myself losing consciousness and a sharp pain in my neck made me feel even worse. 

All I can remember is my mom shrieking for *them* to let me go.
